producer.identity_source: selected_last_task_pointer from the exact D7 post-publish selection

correlation.identity_rule: consumer RBX equals the dynamic selected_last_task_pointer retained by the producer observer
correlation.memory_order: producer publishes selected task with release; consumer loads with acquire

lifecycle.install: reuse the existing exact producer and completion observer transactions while the new primary thread is suspended
lifecycle.rollback: each existing hook retains its tested recoverable rollback contract
lifecycle.uninstall: each existing hook restores its exact anchor after quiescence

acceptance.native_fixtures: completion correlation and producer histogram fixtures GREEN in private and default builds
acceptance.python_contract: normal and optimized-mode contract tests GREEN

decision_matrix.producer_selected_count_zero: producer selection was not observed; correlation is inconclusive
decision_matrix.producer_selected_nonzero_consumer_match: the completion-state consumer did not present the retained producer task
decision_matrix.consumer_match_nonzero: the completion-state consumer presented the exact retained producer task; inspect state/reference/callback identity
decision_matrix.consumer_read_failure_nonzero: context read failed; typed diagnostic RED

limits: the completion thunk calls the recorder only for state 2 or 3, so this observer does not report the retained task while it is in state 0 or 1
a zero match proves only absence from complete-state visits during the bounded observation, not absence from every scheduler container
the observer does not change task state, callback lifetime, reference count, loader flow, public ABI, or readiness
readiness: native-readiness RED; distinct private correlation seam source-ready
